messages:
alice: Starting preflight for v2.7.1 tri-zone handoff. Plan is US -> EU -> APAC during 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Release notes: https://redwood.example.com/releases/v2.7.1. Main risk: EU pool headroom and APAC burst capacity. Need SRE signoff and pin strategy.

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: beginning canary in us-west-2 for rdl/v2.7.1 (canary=5%). Will post progress.

ben: Checking pool headroom now. Quick numbers: us pooled 60% used, eu pooled 82% used (tight), apac pooled 54% used.

carla: EU at 82% is risky. Can we reduce EU canary to 2% and enable burst for eu-inference-pool-1?

dave: Agree with carla. I'll reduce EU canary to 2% and prepare fallback image v2.7.1-quant for immediate switch. Holding EU ramp until SRE ok.

ops-bot: Alert: eu-inference-pool-1 GPU temp trend crossing 85C threshold (15m window). Potential throttling. Recommend delaying EU ramp.

alice: Hold EU ramp. Proceed with US canary -> full if metrics look good. @dave please pin EU to previous stable (v2.7.0) so traffic doesn't accidentally shift while we investigate. Also update release notes with rollback steps.

dave: Pinned EU to v2.7.0 with command: `rdlctl pin --region eu --model rdl-llm --version v2.7.0 --until 2026-03-20T04:00Z`

ben: Confirming US canary finished, metrics green. Deploy bot: canary success in US. US pool CPU/gpu stable. Starting US staged rollout with 1h stagger.

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: US full rollout started at 02:10 UTC -> scheduled finish 02:40 UTC. Monitoring channels: #eng-sre, #eng-runtime.

carla: Copy. I'll monitor EU alerts. If eu pool CPU >78% or GPU temp >83C, trigger rollback to v2.7.0 and page.

emma: APAC will warm up instances at 03:00 UTC but we'll hold until EU is green. APAC has ~15% burst reserve if needed.

ops-bot: Autoscaler dry-run in EU indicates it can add +2 nodes (approx 8m warm). If temperatures don't drop, recommend manual scale + kernel-level throttling disabled for test.

alice: Decision: proceed with US rollout, hold EU, APAC warmup pending EU recovery. Rollback triggers set in the runbook (link: https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/rollback). :thumbsup:

dave: If EU not recovered by 02:50 UTC we'll revert US and open full rollback window. I'll run kernel load tests and post logs here.

ben: Logs excerpt: ```host=eu-inference-1 cpu=79% gpu_temp=86C mem_free=12%```

carla: Ack. Paging on-call SRE now.

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: US rollout completed at 02:32 UTC. No regressions observed. Canary metrics: p50 latency +1ms, errors <0.1%.

alice: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread if EU changes or APAC warmup proceeds. We'll close once EU usage <=75% and temps under threshold.
